note: FALLBACK SNAPSHOT ONLY. The Notion page is the source of truth. Rates here mirror the AMERICANFLAT Yusen MSA (draft 7.15.2026; rates confirmed final by Anthony 8/5/26; validity April 2026 - March 31 2027) as rebuilt onto the Notion card 2026-08-05. US & Canada are USD; Netherlands is EUR + 21% VAT (see references/netherlands.md). Update at contract renewal.

fontana._pallet_note: AF-9: $10.00 national all-in pallet INCLUSIVE of stretch wrap. Any separate wrap line (4.317-4.347) or 14.317 combined rate is DISPUTED, not a rate.

new_jersey._pallet_note: AF-9: $10.00 national all-in pallet INCLUSIVE of stretch wrap. Any separate wrap line (4.317-4.347) or 14.317 combined rate is DISPUTED, not a rate.

south_carolina._pallet_note: AF-9: $10.00 national all-in pallet INCLUSIVE of stretch wrap. Any separate wrap line (4.317-4.347) or 14.317 combined rate is DISPUTED, not a rate.

storage._pending_review: Resolved 2026-08-05: MSA rates confirmed final (SC 3.35 / NJ 4.34 / Fontana 4.47, effective billing weeks from ~May 4-10 2026). Pre-June history: SC 5.0925 / NJ 5.98 / Fontana 5.9055. Bases unchanged: SC = peak-day pallets, NJ = flat count, Fontana = locations + bulk.

labor_tax.note: 5% NJ admin labor tax, applied only during active_periods (each interval is [from, until); from=null means open start, until=null means open-ended; an interval may carry its own 'rate' to override). History: active through the week of April 13 (last taxed invoice billed 2026-04-20 at $1,124.55); dropped from the week of April 20 (invoiced 2026-04-27 at $1,071.00). If the tax returns, append another interval (e.g. {"from": "2026-09-01", "until": null}).

netherlands.basis_note: Outbound priced per CARTON (not per order). 2025 cost levels, subject to annual Panteia/NEA indexation. €6,222/month minimum for warehouse activities.

small_parcel_dtc.note: €2.89/carton includes shipping-label application (no separate label fee).

outbound_b2b.note: 'Outbound Order Fulfillment B2B' €1.89/carton includes pallet config, wrapping, pack-list (covers stretchwrap). NL does not separate VC small-parcel vs LTL.

transport.transport_outbound: variable (weight/volume/lane tariff) — not rate-card checkable without the Benelux freight tariff
transport.note: Outbound EU delivery invoices: per-order Transport Outbound + Fuel Surcharge (% of transport) + Amazon Delivery (flat €100). Subject to 21% VAT.

footnotes.new_jersey_admin: New Jersey weekly $1,071 base = $1,124.55 with 5% labor tax
footnotes.canada_admin: Canada $1,000 acct mgmt + $100 WMS portal = $1,100 — billed MONTHLY per the Brampton worksheet (verified on CA2WFS0003428, June 2026); the Notion card labels it weekly and needs correcting
